data.description:
Placeholder for the suite-growth-vs-coverage pillar of the test creation calibration North Star (was 643f-7f3a).

Goal: per-PR (or per-epic) metrics on test-type composition and suite growth, gated such that suite size grows in proportion to behavioral coverage rather than line count. Detect and surface regressions where N tests are added but behavioral coverage of staged source did not increase.

Out of scope: generation-time prevention (sibling epic); feedback loop from bugs/review findings (sibling epic); post-hoc phantom-mapping detection (c13f-6196).

Refine via /dso:brainstorm.
data.title: Test creation calibration (b): suite growth tracks behavioral coverage, not line count
